title: IT Internship - Cloud Engineer
description:
IT Internship - Application transformation journey to MDP on iAWS, On Prem and beyond
Becoming an IT professional that you aspire to be

About the Internship
Swisscom is always keen on attracting and developing the best talents. As part of the leading telecom and tech company in Switzerland, you will work on real projects that have real impact. From day one, you will be part of an international team collaborating across Switzerland, Rotterdam, and Riga, contributing to innovative solutions in Swisscom’s digital transformation. This means working hands‑on in backend, cloud, or full‑stack development, applying your Computer Science skills to real technical challenges.
With colleagues from over 60 nationalities, diversity is not just something we value, it is how we work. We believe in open collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. You will be encouraged to share ideas, take initiative, and grow within the environment. We respect each other, help each other out, and are not afraid to make mistakes. We make sure you can be the best version of yourself.
Our internship program starts on 1st February 2027. In this 6 months internship you will work in agile teams using Scrum and SAFe, gaining hands-on experience in a fast-paced and supportive environment.

About the Internship Project:
Application transformation journey to MDP on iAWS, On Prem and beyond
The application transformation goal is to enable the Swisscom application team in its transformation of their application to have a fully secured, cloud native application running on the curated for Swisscom AWS infrastructure (iAWS) or On Prem on iKube2.

Must-haves: Git
Nice-to-haves: Kubernetes; AWS; Docker; CI/CD

Who are you?
You are a student enrolled in the last year of your HBO or University program in the field of Computer Science, Informatica, or any other similar field.

You live in the Netherlands.

You are willing to contribute to an international team and you have an agile mindset.

You are curious and responsible.

You have a good level of English; any other language is a plus.

Please note that for non-EU students, it is necessary to provide the NUFFIC Agreement for the 6-month internship from your university in order to be eligible.

Perks
810 € gross Monthly Allowance (Full time)

IT Equipment

Agile working environment and lean management instructor

Flexible working time model

Plenty of opportunities for training and personal development

International Environment

Holidays & time off

Contact

Dit ga je doen
Word een technisch operator/site engineer voor een familiebedrijf en verdien een brutosalaris dat kan oplopen tot wel € 3.650,- per maand. Hier kom je terecht in een warme familiaire omgeving waar je alle ruimte en vertrouwen krijgt om je werk te doen. Daarnaast bieden ze verschillende mogelijkheden voor trainingen en cursussen om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat de sorteermachines soepel blijven draaien tijdens de werkdagen. Ook ontvang je een reiskostenvergoeding, een direct contract en andere voordelen! Nieuwsgierig naar meer? Lees verder en solliciteer vandaag nog!
Manpower zoekt in regio Waddinxveen naar technisch operators/site engineers.
Stel je voor: het is avond en je bent aan het werk op de locatie van het grootste postorderbedrijf van Nederland. Plotseling wordt het stil en beginnen de rode lampjes op je scherm te knipperen. Er is een storing! Als site engineer ben jij de sleutelfiguur bij het oplossen van deze uitdaging. Samen met je team zorg je ervoor dat de sorteermachines blijven functioneren. Je detecteert en verhelpt storingen, voert preventief onderhoud uit en zorgt voor nauwkeurige rapportage. Dit is jouw wereld: vol spanning, uitdaging en voldoening. Jij gaat je bezighouden met de volgende werkzaamheden:
Signaleren, analyseren en oplossen van eerstelijns storingen
Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud
Rapporteren in het systeem om toekomstige storingen sneller op te lossen
Dit krijg je
Brutosalaris van € 2.600,- tot € 3.650,- per maand
Direct op contract bij opdrachtgever
Reiskostenvergoeding volgens regeling van de opdrachtgever
Fulltime baan van 40 uur per week
Onregelmatigheidstoeslag van 25%, 50% en 100%
25 vakantiedagen en de optie om vijf extra dagen te kopen
Collectieve zorgverzekering
Opleiding on-the-job tot zelfstandig servicemonteur
Aanvullende cursussen, zoals VCA, Elektrisch Schakelen, onderhoudstechniek, procesautomatisering en NEN3140
Hier ga je werken
Onze opdrachtgever is een echt familiebedrijf. Ze dragen zorg voor advies en verkoop, inbedrijfstelling, service en support. Hun internationale klanten zijn gespecialiseerd in het sorteren van postpakketten en hebben meerdere locaties in Nederland en België. Het hoofdkantoor staat in Ede, maar de medewerkers wonen en werken op diverse klantlocaties in de hele Benelux. Het team in de Benelux bestaat momenteel uit meer dan 170 collega's. Ze streven naar de hoogste prestaties, helpen elkaar en maken elkaar succesvol. Hun medewerkers worden met respect en vertrouwen behandeld, wat zorgt voor een hele transparante communicatie en wederzijdse feedback. Ze denken en handelen als één bedrijf!
We kunnen op dit moment niet meer informatie geven over deze organisatie. In de vervolgstappen van het sollicitatieproces kunnen we jou hier wel van op de hoogte brengen.
Werktijden
De werktijden in deze fulltime functie zijn tijdens drieploegendiensten.
Dit neem je mee
Elektrotechnische vaardigheden, of je bent bereid om deze aan te leren
Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken in een functie waarbij je veel verantwoordelijkheid hebt
Beschikbaarheid van 40 uur per week
Bezit van rijbewijs B en een auto
Leergierigheid en probleemoplossend vermogen
Flexibele instelling (want je werkt op verschillende locaties)

mail

title: Engineering Manager
description:
📍Eindhoven HQ (3 days in office) | 🗓️ 40hrs per week

🚀 This is what you tell people at parties

We didn't become Europe's leading e-commerce shipping platform by playing it safe. Sendcloud powers 30,000+ online retailers, marketplaces, and fulfillment companies. Helping them ship smarter, grow faster, and actually get shit done for their customers. Boring logistics? Not here. We're building the platform that solves shipping, at scale, globally!

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead one or more feature teams building the product experiences, integrations, and capabilities that help merchants run their shipping operations with less friction and more control. You'll sit at the intersection of Engineering, Product, and Design, turning complex customer and logistics problems into reliable, scalable, high-impact solutions — and you'll do it by building healthy, high-performing teams that balance strong delivery ownership with real engineering quality.

🧐 The Role

Role Description

As the Engineering Manager, you're responsible for the people, delivery, technical health, and operational ownership of one or more feature teams within Sendcloud Engineering.

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, senior engineers, Platform teams, and other stakeholders to define team goals, shape priorities, and deliver meaningful product outcomes for customers.

Your mission is to create an environment where engineers do their best work, teams have clarity and ownership, and delivery stays predictable without compromising quality, reliability, or long-term maintainability.

You lead through context, coaching, and accountability — helping the team understand the "why," challenging priorities when needed, removing blockers, and making sure what you build scales with the business.

🎯 What you'll do

Strategy & Organisation: Translate Product and Tech strategy into clear team goals, improve team structure and ways of working, and keep the team aligned with engineering standards and organisational priorities.

People & Hiring: Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, feedback, performance management, career development, hiring, onboarding, and retention.

Delivery & Execution: Own end-to-end delivery for your team(s), manage scope and risks, remove blockers, and drive predictable execution without compromising quality.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the main engineering partner for Product and Design, co-own planning and prioritisation, challenge decisions constructively, and communicate progress and risks clearly to stakeholders.

Technical Direction & Quality: Partner with senior engineers to guide architecture, engineering standards, code quality, documentation, test automation, and technical debt management.

Operational Excellence: Ensure the team owns its services in production, including observability, incident management, post-mortems, runbooks, SLOs, security, privacy, and compliance-related work.

Continuous Improvement: Use team metrics, delivery insights, incidents, and retrospectives to improve team performance, collaboration, reliability, and engineering effectiveness.

Budget & Cost Awareness: Manage team-level tool, activity, and cloud/resource usage responsibly, and propose investments where they create clear value for the team or business.

✅ What you bring to the table

Personally

You are clear, direct and empathetic — you know how to give honest feedback without creating fear, and how to support people without avoiding accountability.

You are structured and calm under pressure, able to manage competing priorities, delivery risks, people topics, and stakeholder expectations without creating chaos for the team.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — you don't wait for perfect instructions, you create clarity, align people, and move things forward.

You have high ownership and low ego — you care more about solving the problem than being right, and you lead by example in how you communicate, collaborate, and make decisions.

You are motivated by building strong teams, developing engineers, improving systems, and helping people do meaningful work at scale.

You are energised by turning customer problems into product outcomes, bringing a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and pragmatism to solutions that are simple, scalable, and impactful.

Professionally

You have 7+ years of experience in software engineering or engineering leadership, including at least 3 years in Engineering Management.

You have managed engineers directly, including coaching, feedback, performance management, career development, promotions, and retention.

You have experience managing teams of around 10+ people or a comparable scope across multiple teams, projects, or technical domains.

You have worked in an engineering organisation with at least 50+ engineers and understand the coordination, communication, and scaling challenges that come with that environment.

You have a strong background in software engineering and product development, with enough technical depth to challenge decisions, support senior engineers, and reason about architecture, quality, and operational trade-offs.

You have proven experience partnering with Product Management, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities, manage scope, and deliver customer and business impact.

You have experience driving delivery, execution, and continuous improvement in engineering teams, ideally in Agile or iterative product development environments.

You have experience with hiring, interviewing, and developing engineering talent, and you know what good looks like for strong engineering teams.

You understand production ownership, including incident management, observability, runbooks, operational excellence, security, and privacy-aware development practices.

You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken, and can adapt your message to engineers, Product stakeholders, senior leadership, and non-technical audiences.

❤️ Our Values

💩 No bullshit: Big egos suck. Be open, honest and transparent. Share your mistakes openly and learn from them. Don't just talk about problems, solve them.

🎯 Grow & win: Be highly curious, adaptable & proactive. Embrace discomfort and change. Keep an open mindset and learn from others. You invest in our growth, so we invest in yours.

🎠 Have fun: Work hard, laugh harder. Not everything has to be serious. Be yourself, especially if you're the good kind of crazy. Sendcloud is an adventure, not a corporate maze, enjoy the ride.

🎉 Benefits

💸 Salary - From €90,000 gross annually, inclusive of 8% holiday pay (based on your specific skillset and professional background).

🧠 Brain Benefits - €2,000 learning budget · Courses, certifications & conferences · Growth in an international team

🌴 Time Benefits - 28 days of paid vacations per year · Extra day off on your birthday · Swap public holidays for meaningful ones

✈️ Sabbatical Benefits - 4 weeks fully paid every 3 years

🏡 Home Benefits - Flexible hybrid model (3+ days/week in office) · €500 home office budget

💪 Body Benefits - Company gym · Free lunch every Monday · Fresh fruit · Barista coffee

🚌 Travel Benefits - Monthly commuting allowance

🪑 Future Benefits - Pension scheme · Employee discount programs

🐾 Vibe Benefits - Dog-friendly office · After-hours drinks at the Sendcloud Bar

title: Working Student – Data Engineering
description:
Build AI that works in the real world
Who we are
Founded in 2006, Rewire is an applied AI company helping organizations reinvent how they work with data and AI. We partner with leading organizations across industries to create scalable business impact by solving complex challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our team of 100+ data scientists, engineers, and change agents operates across Europe from offices in the Netherlands and Germany. What makes us the right choice for you
Deepen your skills in data & AI – gain exposure to diverse industries, tackle real-world challenges, and grow through hands-on projects and expert mentorship in a future-focused environment

Benefit from personal coaching – receive regular guidance and feedback from experienced professionals who are committed to your growth

Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand

Look ahead with strong future prospects – take the opportunity to grow into a full-time role after your studies and kick-start your career in data & AI

What makes you shine

A hands-on, growth mindset – you take initiative, embrace challenges, and are eager to learn and develop continuously

If you're hesitating because you don't meet every requirement, don't let that hold you back. Strong candidates often underestimate how well they fit a role. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply!

Most of your work will take place from our Amsterdam office, where you'll collaborate closely with colleagues and contribute to a variety of projects while gaining hands-on experience in a dynamic and international environment. Discover more about its inspiring atmosphere here.

Additionaly, I get to work alongside some of the smartest and most driven people in the field. Combined with the great culture and activities it makes Rewire a genuinely enjoyable place to work.” – Duncan van Woerkom - Data Engineer at Rewire

Our selection process includes an initial screening, a capacity test, a recruiter conversation, and two interviews. Along the way, we'll learn more about each other and explore whether we're a great match.
Apply now! Let’s see where this journey takes us.
Questions? Feel free to ask them via [e-mail] – we’re happy to chat.
Who you are matters to us!
We welcome all applicants – regardless of gender, background, or LGBT+ identity – because diversity and inclusion are core values for us. We are convinced that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and success.
We believe diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to building a more diverse engineering team and particularly encourage women and other underrepresented groups in technology to apply.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Are you a Software Engineer who loves moving fast, taking full ownership of and pushing the boundaries of technology with cutting-edge AI coding agents? If you thrive on building high-impact fintech features,  this role is for you.

Your role
You won’t be stuck in corporate hierarchy here, we find hierarchy a difficult word. Instead, you’ll join a cross-functional team alongside product, design, and business colleagues. Together, you own a specific part of the customer journey end-to-end: from landing pages to loan applications, repayments, and collections. Real ownership, zero passing the buck.

Your responsibilities
The interesting part: our lending platform grew 55% last year and has to keep scaling, and we experiment every day with how coding agents change the way software gets built. Day to day, you:

Build features end to end across backend, frontend, database and queues: TypeScript with NestJS and Next.js, on Postgres, Redis, SNS and SQS

Connect systems by building and maintaining integrations with external partners and internal services, e.g. credit bureaus, payment providers, our CRM (HubSpot) and our loan ledger (Mambu)

Partner up with business departments to decide what gets built and why

Leverage AI: experiment with coding agents and push the boundaries of how software gets built safely and fast

Keep the codebase safe to change as we scale: tests, contracts between services, alerts, reviewing agent-generated code

Ship small and verify in production: logs, traces and metrics in Grafana, errors in Sentry, feature flags and A/B tests in PostHog

Run what you ship on AWS and Kubernetes, with infrastructure in Terraform and pipelines in GitLab CI

Production support and blameless incident follow-up that fixes the system, not the person

What you bring
5+ years of hands-on full stack engineering experience in any programming language, with real production ownership

Solid database and async systems experience: data modelling, schema migrations on live systems, query performance; queues, retries, idempotency

Curious and already actively experimenting with AI coding agents and agentic workflows.

Analytical mindset—you find the true "source of truth" before patching anything.

A team player who cuts through the noise. You turn vague ideas into sharp questions, pull the right colleagues in early, and give code reviews that actually move the work forward.

Familiarity with cloud-native technology and its tooling, e.g. containers, orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure as code

Experience in fintech, web tracking, or marketing tools is a nice bonus, but not a dealbreaker.

Who we are
While small businesses drive the economy, when it comes to financing, traditional systems still move at the speed of paper. We founded BridgeFund in 2018 to change that. We've stripped away the bureaucracy: an entrepreneur applies in just five minutes, and our advanced technology processes the data quickly and efficiently. By combining cutting-edge automation with real human logic, we make financing decisions that are both fast and fair. We grew 55% last year and have proudly fast-tracked over €700 million in loans to entrepreneurs. Our next goal? To scale our data capabilities by making our platform even sharper, ensuring support for the next generation of entrepreneurs

What we offer
A competitive salary between €6,358 and €6,930 based on 40 hours per week. Growth is intentional here. We use an internal competency framework to help you track your progress and continuously evolve in your role.
A hybrid model, requiring three days per week in our office.

6% pension via ASR Doen Pensioen

25 paid vacation days and 8% holiday allowance

Two weeks per year of remote work from abroad

Travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer (even if you cycle)

€40 Epassi budget per month for things like TrainMore, Uber, or a day out

BridgeFund Academy for personal growth, learning, and coaching

Annual Learning & Development budget of €1,500 for your professional growth

Modern workspace with a MacBook, open areas, quiet zones, and zero ceiling tiles

Bridge Day: one extra day off for something that matters to you

Company boat The Royal Ted for team events or private use

Sports activities such as boxing classes and a running club

50% paid lunches

Free snacks: healthy and not-so-healthy

Friday drinks, quarterly parties, and team outings

BridgeFun(d) bar with DJ booth, stage, and karaoke

Curious?
Good. That is usually how the best engineers start here at BridgeFund. Apply directly or reach out to Anna-Maria at [e-mail]. We would love to hear what you would build next.

title: Assembly & Test Technician
description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

Job Title:
Assembly & Test Technician
Reporting To:
Management, General Manufacturing & Operations
Work Schedule:
Onsite – Amsterdam, NLMoog B.V. in Nieuw Vennep is een van Nederlands pure mechatronische ondernemingen waar de unieke combinatie van werken met software, electronica en mechanica wordt geboden. "Moog B.V.", ontwerpt, fabriceert en levert sinds 25 jaar mechatronisch- en hydraulisch-mechanische 'turn-key' producten voor o.a. de luchtvaart-, ruimtevaart- en automobielindustrie.

(125 medewerkers) afwisselend werk in de boeiende markt van de luchtvaart en de automotive industrie. Binnen Operations is het team Assembly & Test verantwoordelijk voor de complete assemblage en het testen van de producten van MOOG, vanaf ontvangst goederen op de werkvloer tot en met bijbehorende kwaliteitscontroles. De assemblage van onze systemen geschiedt in eigen huis om de kwaliteit op een zo hoog mogelijk niveau te kunnen waarborgen. De werkzaamheden bieden de variatie die onlosmakelijk is verbonden met het produceren mechatronische systemen: productieklaar maken van aangeleverde onderdelen, mechanisch en elektrisch assembleren van de systemen, testen, transportklaar maken van de systemen en assistentie verlenen bij het opbouwen van de systemen bij klanten.

· Kennis van Hydraulica is een pre.
· Enige jaren werkervaring.
· Bezit goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel schriftelijk als wel mondeling en functioneert goed in een omgeving waarbij het team centraal staat.
· Is in staat onderdelen op kwaliteit te inspecteren volgens de aangegeven normen / specificaties.
· In staat om middels technische tekeningen en documentatie complexere systemen samen te bouwen en te testen.
· Is bekend of heeft affiniteit met Continu Verbeteren op de werkvloer (Lean manufacturing)
· Werkzaamheden op locatie (eventueel installaties in het buitenland).
· Eventuele bereidheid tot reizen.
· Beheersing van de Engelse taal.
· Basis kennis van Outlook, en overige microsoft programma's als Word en Excel.
· Certificaten van Veilig werken (hijsen, heftruck, VCA).

Wat bieden wij?
Wij bieden de kans om uitdagend werk te doen in een zeer dynamische hightech internationale omgeving. Het salaris en secundaire voorwaarden zijn conform Moog BV CAO en goed in overeenstemming met de zwaarte van de functie.
De baan biedt een ruime mate van uitdaging met de mogelijkheid om veel te leren, contacten te onderhouden met internationale klanten en collega’s en kennis te maken met een verscheidenheid aan hightech-toepassingen.

Geïnteresseerd?

title: Test Engineer
description:
Imagine standing at the very intersection where innovation meets reality. On one side, our engineers are designing cutting-edge UAV systems; on the other, production teams are assembling machines that will define the future of defense. We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our Testing Team, with a strong focus on automating test activities for electronic systems and laboratory setups. This role involves close collaboration with R&D and Production teams, while being an integral part of the Testing Team, contributing to the development of both software and hardware solutions aimed at improving test efficiency, repeatability, and reliability.
At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for test activities.

Write scripts and software applications to control test rigs, measurement instruments, and data acquisition systems.
Develop and maintain software interfaces, including web-based interfaces, for test control and monitoring.
Contribute to the definition of test system architectures (hardware + software).
Support debugging and troubleshooting of electronic systems under test.
Create and maintain technical documentation for test tools and procedures.

Requirements
What You’ll Need
Strong programming and automation skills
Proficiency in Python (primary language)
Knowledge of additional programming languages (e.g. C/C++, JavaScript, etc.) is a plus
Hands-on, problem-solving mindset
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams (software and hardware)
Experience with PCB design, testing, or debugging
Web development experience for building test user interfaces
Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQ systems, sensors)
CAD design experience
3D printing for prototyping fixtures, enclosures, or test accessories
Experience working with complex hardware test environments

Who You Are
You are a hands-on engineer who feels at home where hardware meets software, comfortable moving between lab setups, electronic systems, and automation code without friction. You naturally understand how complex systems behave, allowing you to translate test needs into robust automated solutions that improve efficiency, repeatability, and reliability. You enjoy collaborating closely with R&D and Production teams, speaking the same technical language and keeping a strong focus on real-world constraints. Quality matters to you, especially in high-stakes environments, and you take ownership of building test systems that engineers can trust.
Benefits
Why Join Us?
✨ The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
✨ Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
✨ Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
✨ Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.
Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.
🚀 Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

title: Research Engineer - Digital Transformation Engineer
description:
Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.
Job Summary

At GKN Aerospace, we are shaping the next generation of aircraft manufacturing. By leveraging smart digital technologies, data analytics, and innovative production methods, we make our processes smarter, faster, and more efficient.

As a Research Engineer - Digital Transformation Engineer, you will be part of our Aerospace R&D team in the Netherlands. You will collaborate with engineers, manufacturing experts, and technology partners to develop practical solutions for the challenges of tomorrow.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will actively contribute to the digital transformation of our manufacturing and engineering environment. You will help turn data into valuable insights and support projects that improve the way we work.

Support digital improvement initiatives across manufacturing and engineering.

Develop and maintain data-driven solutions that connect people, processes, and technology.

Translate manufacturing challenges into practical, data-driven solutions.

Collaborate with colleagues across engineering, operations, IT, and external technology partners.

Help implement and further develop new digital manufacturing technologies.

Present technical insights and results clearly to a variety of audiences.

Explore and evaluate emerging developments in artificial intelligence, data analytics, and digital manufacturing.

Job Qualifications

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a curious and analytically minded professional who is energized by innovation and technological advancement.

Knowledge of modern digital manufacturing technologies and smart factory applications.

Experience with databases, system integrations, and industrial data platforms.

Understanding of data analytics and the development of scalable data solutions.

The ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and understandable way.

The ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

A self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to prioritize effectively.

Nice to Have

Do you also have experience with or an interest in the topics below? That's a plus, but certainly not a requirement.

Interest in or experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative AI.

Knowledge of digital twins, simulation technologies, or decision-support systems.

Experience with software development, automation, or cloud-based solutions.

Familiarity with tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and version control systems.

Experience working within a manufacturing environment.

What We Offer

At GKN Aerospace, you will have the opportunity to work on technologies that contribute to the production of the aircraft of the future. You'll be given the freedom to explore new ideas, experiment, and develop innovative solutions. In addition, we offer an attractive benefits package, including:

A salary within Scale K of the Metalektro Collective Labour Agreement, ranging from €3,952 to €5,712 gross per month, depending on experience.

40 days of annual leave (based on a full-time position).

8% holiday allowance.

A competitive PME pension scheme and travel allowance.

Why GKN Aerospace?

At GKN Aerospace, we believe innovation starts with curious people. That's why we invest in your development and provide the space to explore new technologies, experiment, and make a real impact. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace manufacturing.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further.  And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN.  We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute.  It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’.  By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology. ​
​

title: Head of AI & Analytics Model Risk
description:
At a glance

In February 2025, the Risk Management mission has been reset to address the challenges and pain points. The mission of the CRO organisation is ‘we deliver sound and simple Risk Management solutions to increase our resilience while enabling our client’s success and the banks growth’, with the vision to ‘secure risk excellence in the heart of ABN AMRO’. Therefore, the CRO organisation focusses on four strategic pillars: Simplicity, Execution Focus, Risks that Matter and Risk Culture. These strategic pillars rely on their People, Innovation, Seamless Processing, Governance & Organisation to successfully realise the Risk Management Vision.

AI & Analytics Model Risk department, within Model Risk Management & Model Validation (MRM&MV), is a culturally diverse team of approximately 8-10 highly qualified professionals, located in Amsterdam. The team is responsible for model risk management and validation of models within the AI, FEC, and other relevant analytical domains, which includes models used by CRO IT & Cyber, Compliance (incl. SIM), Brand Marketing & Communications, Group Audit, Central Operations Office (inc. DFC), Innovation & Technology, Human Resources, and all generative AI models throughout the bank.

ABN AMRO is looking for an experienced leader for the department. We are looking for someone with a strategic vision, and a determination and presence to follow through, with the aim to improve and innovate. You have deep expertise in international financial markets, related models and relevant regulations, who can lead a diverse team of high value specialists.

Your job

Leads the implementation and execution of the Model Risk Management Framework, including model discovery, tiering, inventory management, validation, risk reporting, risk monitoring, and risk assessment, as well as setting the Risk Appetite Statement.
Directs and coordinates the tracking of all outstanding model-related findings and ensures timely assessment and closure of requests.
Oversees the management and administration of the Methodology Acceptance Groups (MAGs), as well as model risk reporting.
Defines and maintains model validation requirements and procedures.
Identifies and signals issues or problems through validation and other oversight activities, providing proposals for corrective actions.
Transition from MV focus to MRM&MV orientation of teams.
Integration of MRM tasks with MV department.
Change in way of working from process orientated to risk aware prioritization and execution.
Expand coverage of MRM over full organization.
Foster a deep understanding of model risk and risk management in general within the team.

Working environment

The AI & Analytics Model Risk department is part of ABN AMRO’s Model Risk Management & Model Validation (MRM&MV) department. There are three other model risk teams within the MRM&MV department: Financial Markets Model Risk, Retail Credit Model Risk, Non-Retail Credit Model Risk. You are member of the management team of the MRM&MV department and report directly to the head of MRM&MV. The head of MRM&MV reports directly to the CRO.

Key stakeholders of your department are within the various functions (COO, I&T), Risk (Compliance, CRO IT & Cyber), senior management, internal & external auditors and the ECB and other regulators.

Your profile

Ideal Experience
Academic degree with at least 10 years’ experience working as leader
Relevant and proven experience within risk management
Proven track record in maintaining and strengthening stakeholder relationships at ELG and ELT level.
Deep model risk knowledge and robust risk management toolkit.
Extensive knowledge of risk management practices and banking business, including in-depth knowledge of products and client propositions, corresponding risk, regulations and models
Extensive experience in managing teams with highly skilled and trained professionals
Good understanding of the developments in the financial industry and the ability to relate this to the activities of ABN AMRO

Behaviour we want to see within Risk Management
Debate, debate, decide: Gain different perspectives on impact throughout the value chain. Then take the decision, accept the decision and respect single accountability & responsibility
Keep it simple: Start with the goal, set well-defined requirements, proactively address dependencies, seek feasibility in plans and don’t overpromise. No abbreviations.
Embrace Good: Don't go for perfect, do what’s right and compliant
From being nice to being kind: Ask and act on feedback, be open about the good, bad and ugly. Reflect, adapt and move forward.
No excuses – stay the course: Take the lead, own it. Act quickly, standardize progress updates to ensure timely support and escalate

Other personal characteristics
Strong execution capability and a results-oriented mindset.
Clear vision and strategy for your department, contributing to the bank-wide strategy.
Natural relationship builder who drives constructive cross-department collaboration.

We are offering

We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.
In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

Interested?

Interested in this position? Please send us your application! For more information you can contact Pieter de Boer ([e-mail]), Model Risk Management & Model Validation or Robert van den Boogaard ([e-mail]), Talent Acquisition Specialist.

We are looking forward to meeting you!

Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable

At ABN AMRO, we believe in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being a personal bank in the digital age aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

Disclaimer external recruitment agencies

External recruitment agencies need to have a signed agreement with ABN AMRO BANK N.V., executed by a Talent Acquisition Specialist, when submitting a resume to a vacancy. No unsolicited services or offers, please.

title: Public Services Technology Internship
description:
Job Description
Are you a master's student with a passion for how technology can transform government and public services?
At Accenture Netherlands, you'll discover how AI, cybersecurity, and large-scale digital transformation projects can deliver measurable value for public sector organizations. Guided by experienced consultants, you'll build practical skills that will serve you throughout your career. This internship challenges you to combine academic curiosity with an innovative mindset to create real societal impact through technology.
Your primary focus will be on the public sector, but as part of the broader Health & Public Services (HPS) team, you'll also gain exposure to healthcare projects, giving you a broad view of technology-driven transformation across both domains.
Duration: 4 to 9 months, starting in February or March.
How to apply: Submit your CV and a cover letter (preferably in Dutch) explaining your interest in Accenture Netherlands and this internship. Please clearly indicate your preferred start date, the length of your internship, and whether you are applying for a work placement or a thesis internship.
What you'll do
As an intern, you'll work alongside consultants on real client projects, supporting public sector organizations such as ministries with national and international dependencies, government executive agencies, and institutions in the field of justice and safety. You'll help them become more innovative, agile, and future proof through the responsible application of technology.
You'll gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to projects with tangible outcomes such as cost savings, more efficient and faster case handling, or optimized government processes.
What to expect
Working internship: You'll have the opportunity to shape your own experience and explore your personal interests. You'll contribute to various projects including business analyses, stakeholder and market analyses, support in developing business proposals, and research into client systems and functionalities. You are encouraged to bring your own ideas and initiatives, so you can challenge yourself and get the most out of your internship.
Thesis internship: It is also possible — in consultation with your supervisor — to combine your internship with writing your thesis. You are encouraged to choose a topic that aligns with your studies and adds value to one of our clients. You'll receive all the guidance and resources needed to complete your thesis while continuing to contribute to the HPS team.
How we reinvent
This internship sits within our Industry & Enterprise Technology practice, where we combine deep sector expertise with advanced technology to deliver 360° value for our clients. You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team working on the future of intelligent public services, leveraging our global delivery model and strategic partnerships with ecosystem partners such as Microsoft, AWS, and Google.

What we're looking for

Education: Currently enrolled in a master's program at a Dutch university for the full duration of the internship. Preferred fields of study include Business Information Technology, Data Science & AI, Computer Science, Public Administration, or closely related disciplines.
Skills: Affinity with technology, IT, and/or the public sector; you actively follow the latest technological developments.
Mindset: Ambitious and proactive, naturally analytical, strong communicator, and a team player.
Bonus points: Involvement in extracurricular activities — for example, student organizations, Defensity College, Society College, De Kleine Consultant, etc.
Location: Amsterdam
Languages: Fluent Dutch and English required

What we offer
Learning opportunities: Access to our Learning & Development Platform.
Guidance: Support from a dedicated internship supervisor (People Lead) and a buddy.
Culture & Community: You'll be part of an open culture that actively encourages you to get the most out of your internship. Through close guidance and support, you'll quickly find your footing within both HPS and Accenture NL. Your week will offer a balanced mix of personal development and informal interaction with colleagues at all levels. The more proactive and assertive you are, the more you'll learn and grow.
Extras: Competitive internship allowance and travel expense reimbursement.
Inclusion, Diversity & Social Impact: Do Good Volunteer Program, I&D Networks, Refugee Talent Track.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

Proficient in English.

title: Data Consultant
description:
Wil jij niet alleen met data werken, maar vooral begrijpen wat een organisatie nodig heeft en hierover adviseren?
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat cateringbedrijven precies genoeg maaltijden bereiden zonder onnodige verspilling? Hoe optimaliseer je een logistiek netwerk zodat vrachtwagens minder kilometers rijden? Of hoe help je een organisatie om AI-ready te worden met een stevig datafundament?
Dit zijn voorbeelden van vraagstukken waar jij als Data Consultant bij Incentro mee aan de slag kunt.
Data combineren met consultancy
Als Data Consultant combineer je jouw kennis van data met consultancy. Je gaat met klanten en stakeholders in gesprek, brengt hun uitdagingen en ambities in kaart en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare data-oplossingen.
Je begint daarbij niet met de vraag “Welke techniek gaan we gebruiken?”, maar met “Welk probleem proberen we voor de klant op te lossen?”
Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken die verder gaan dan alleen techniek. Daarbij verbind je business, data en technologie en werk je nauw samen met onze data engineers, data scientists, BI-specialisten en cloud-architecten.
Misschien is dit jouw volgende stap
Een Data Consultant bij Incentro kan verschillende achtergronden hebben. We zoeken niet naar één specifiek profiel, maar naar iemand die data en technologie wil combineren met het begrijpen van organisaties en mensen.
Misschien werk je nu als Data Engineer, BI Developer, ETL Developer, Data Analist, Analytics Engineer of Software Developer en wil je naast de techniek meer adviseren en met de business aan tafel zitten.
Of je bent al actief als Data Consultant, Business Intelligence Consultant of Analytics Consultant, maar zoekt juist meer technische verdieping.
Ook als jouw achtergrond ergens tussen deze rollen in zit, komen we graag met je in gesprek. Je huidige expertise is het vertrekpunt van waaruit je je verder ontwikkelt.
Wat ga je doen?
Als Data Consultant ben je de verbindende factor tussen business, data en technologie.
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
businessvraagstukken analyseren en vertalen naar data-oplossingen;

requirements en klantbehoeften ophalen;

adviseren over data, processen en informatievoorziening;

meewerken aan dataplatformen, pipelines en andere data-oplossingen;

klanten meenemen in keuzes, voortgang en resultaten;

bewaken of de oplossing daadwerkelijk bijdraagt aan het doel van de klant.

Je werkt daarbij voor verschillende organisaties en krijgt de kans om je steeds opnieuw vast te bijten in interessante en complexe vraagstukken.
Van data naar impact
Bij Incentro werk je aan vraagstukken waarvan je het resultaat daadwerkelijk ziet.
Zo werken we aan datagedreven oplossingen voor het slimmer beheren van energienetwerken en het optimaliseren van logistieke processen. Het doel is steeds hetzelfde: niet alleen technisch iets goed bouwen, maar begrijpen welk probleem je ermee oplost en daadwerkelijk waarde creëren voor de klant.
Jouw technische basis
Je hoeft niet alle technologie al te beheersen. Een stevige technische basis en de ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen zijn belangrijker.
Binnen Data Solutions werken we onder andere met:
Python & SQL

Snowflake & dbt

Spark & Airflow

Kubernetes

AWS, GCP & Azure

Terraform & AWS CDK

dataplatformen en ETL-pipelines

machine learning & AI

We zoeken iemand die begrijpt hoe data en technologie werken, maar vooral nieuwsgierig is naar de vraagstukken erachter.
Jij als consultant
Wat je achtergrond ook is: je krijgt energie van data, mensen en vraagstukken. Je bent nieuwsgierig, stelt goede vragen en wilt begrijpen wat er écht speelt voordat je een oplossing bedenkt.
Je kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen, schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en vindt het leuk om voor verschillende organisaties te werken.
Je hebt:
minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een data-gerelateerde rol;

ervaring met bijvoorbeeld Data Engineering, BI, Analytics of Data Consultancy;

ervaring met Python en SQL;

ervaring met een cloudomgeving zoals AWS, GCP of Azure;

interesse in de businessvraagstukken achter data en technologie;

goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

een nieuwsgierige en ondernemende houding;

goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Twijfel je of je voldoende aan dit profiel voldoet? Geen probleem. We kijken graag naar het totaalplaatje: wat je meebrengt, waar je nieuwsgierig naar bent en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.
Jouw team
Je wordt onderdeel van onze Data Solutions-cel, een hechte club van zo’n 40 data engineers, data scientists, BI-specialisten en cloud-architecten.
Je werkt in projectteams met verschillende specialisten, deelt kennis en hebt altijd collega's om mee te sparren. Van kennissessies en trainingen tot samen experimenteren met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data en AI.
We zijn een jonge, ondernemende club waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe ideeën uit te proberen. Ook buiten projecten zoeken we elkaar op tijdens borrels, sportactiviteiten en andere activiteiten.
Onze cultuur draait om Camaraderie, Boldness, Autonomy en Mastery (CBAM). Lees hier meer over op onze pagina over cultuur.

Ook op het gebied van AI willen we vooroplopen. Ons eigen AI-team ontwikkelt oplossingen en experimenteert met nieuwe toepassingen. Zo werk je niet alleen met de technologie van vandaag, maar ontdek je samen met collega's ook wat er morgen mogelijk is.
Wat bieden we jou?
Een salaris tussen €3.500 en €5.500 op basis van 40 uur.

Een vast contract na je proeftijd.

De mogelijkheid om 32–40 uur per week te werken.

Een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, zonder studieschuld.

Een elektrische leaseauto naar keuze óf een mobiliteits-/reiskostenregeling.

Een NS-Business Card voor zakelijke én privéreizen als je geen leaseauto hebt.

27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om er 10 bij te kopen.

Een premievrij pensioen.

Elke vier jaar €2.250 budget om je eigen laptop te kiezen.

Elke drie jaar een vergoeding voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek.

De mogelijkheid om certificaathouder en daarmee mede-eigenaar van Incentro te worden.

Jaarlijks €650 Mastery Money om te investeren in jouw ontwikkeling.

Een maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding.

Aandacht voor diversiteit & inclusiviteit en ondersteuning voor je fysieke én mentale gezondheid.

Daarnaast organiseren we borrels, feestjes en meerdaagse “even-met-elkaar-weg”-trips en om het jaar gaan we samen op Wincentrosport. Meer weten over onze secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden? Kijk in ons handboek!
Klaar voor de volgende stap?
Wil je eerst eens vrijblijvend kennismaken? We bespreken graag waar je nu staat, waar je naartoe wilt en of een rol als Data Consultant bij Incentro daarbij past.
Neem contact op met Dexter van der Swaluw via [telefoon].

title: Senior Strategic Sales Executive
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.
What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Strategic Sales Manager to be based in Amsterdam. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and managing Tencent Cloud’s most important strategic accounts in the Netherlands. This role requires a strategic mindset to define sales priorities, develop and execute action plans, exceed cloud sales targets, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders in target accounts. The individual will play a critical role in driving cloud revenue growth, securing new large strategic clients—especially in e‑commerce, food delivery, gaming, media & entertainment, and FinTech—and leading the negotiation and management of high-value contracts.

Key Responsibilities
Own the full sales cycle: from prospecting and lead generation to closing contracts and driving account expansion.

Build and manage executive-level (C-level) relationships to become a trusted advisor.

Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve and exceed sales quotas.

Act as a product expert on Tencent Cloud's digital native offerings, crafting solution-based proposals.

Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Legal, and Finance to deliver value and close complex deals.

Who We Look For
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience: 10+ years of B2B sales experience in technology/cloud/digital sectors, with a proven track record of selling complex solutions to C-level executives.
Skills: A true "hunter" with outstanding ability to close. Exceptional in consultative selling, negotiation, and executive communication.
Mindset: Highly motivated, goal-oriented self-starter with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Plus: Curiosity and experience in AI; background in E-commerce.
Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in a major European language (e.g., Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese) and/or Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is
Results-driven and quota-obsessed.
A skilled relationship-builder and strategic account manager.
A proactive problem solver and a team collaborator.
Adaptable and a fast learner in a dynamic environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Onderofficier Netwerkbeheerder
description:
Introtekst

Aangezien de opleiding wordt herzien en daardoor de vacature voorlopig dichtstaat, is wellicht de vacature Onderofficier Verbindingsdienst iets voor jou. Met een aanstellingspremie van 6000,- per jaar erg intressant!

Ambieer je een carrière in de ICT? En heb je minimaal een MBO-4 diploma Netwerkbeheerder, ICT-beheerder, Netwerk- en mediabeheer, ICT system engineer, ICT- en mediabeheer of IT Expert Systems and Devices met een voldoende voor Wiskunde en Engels? Kies dan voor een opleiding en aansluitend de functie van
Onderofficier Netwerkbeheerder bij de Koninklijke Marine. Je werkt als ICT’er aan boord van een marineschip en bent als militair, samen met je collega’s, verantwoordelijk voor de verschillende netwerksystemen aan boord en de netwerkverbindingen tussen schepen, vliegtuigen, onderzeeboten, marinierseenheden en de wal.

Dit ga je doen

Als Onderofficier Netwerkbeheerder bij de Marine werk je bij de Operationele Dienst Verbindingen. Hier zorg je ervoor dat de verschillende netwerksystemen aan boord optimaal blijven werken. Daarvoor maak je gebruik van verschillende softwarepakketten om het beheer zo goed mogelijk uit te voeren.
Naast het beheren van de netwerken hoort ook het aannemen, verwerken en doorzetten van storingsmeldingen die te maken hebben met de verschillende netwerksystemen tot je takenpakket. Je stuurt medewerkers aan, begeleidt hen bij hun taken in het Network Operation Center en op die plaatsen in het schip waar netwerksystemen voorkomen. Ook controleer je de uitgevoerde werkzaamheden van je team en ondersteun je het commando van de eenheid met advies en informatie.
PLUSPUNTEN VAN DEZE FUNCTIE
Salaris: je bruto basissalaris levert door toeslagen en onze gunstige reiskosten, pensioen- en ziektekostenregeling je netto een aangename verrassing op.
Werksfeer: nergens maak je deel uit van zo’n hecht team van collega’s als bij Defensie.
Uitdaging: je bent verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie tussen schepen, vliegtuigen, onderzeeboten, marinierseenheden en de wal.
Maatschappelijke bijdrage: Het leveren van een bijdrage aan vrede en veiligheid op en vanuit zee en het beschermen wat ons dierbaar is.
Wereldwijd inzetbaar: je komt op plekken waar je met de meeste andere banen niet zal komen.

Opmerking: Er zijn verschillende startdata in het jaar. Na het solliciteren ontvang je een persoonlijk sollicitatiedossier, waarin een opkomstdatum is vermeld. Let op: dit is een fictieve datum en klopt dus niet. De startdatum waar jij voor in aanmerking komt, wordt pas later bepaald. Dit is onder andere afhankelijk van de uitslag van het psychologisch onderzoek, de medische keuring en het veiligheidsonderzoek, die bij het sollicitatietraject horen. Zodra al deze onderdelen positief zijn afgerond, word jouw startdatum besproken en vastgelegd.

Hier ga je werken

Je werkt afwisselend aan wal of aan boord van de marineschepen van de Koninklijke Marine, die de hele wereld overvaren.
Maar voordat je aan de slag gaat, volg je een opleiding van iets meer dan een jaar. Die bestaat uit: de Maritieme Militaire Vorming en Kaderopleiding (20 weken), de opleiding Horizontaal Instromende Netwerkmanager en een specifieke Defensie IT opleiding (13 weken). Vervolgens ga je varen voor een stageperiode van ca. 6 maanden. Na het succesvol afronden van de opleiding begin je direct aan jouw carrière als Onderofficier Netwerkbeheerder bij de Koninklijke Marine.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Ben jij een Projectcoördinator die het prachtig vindt om bij het realiseren van kleine tot middelgrote projecten de gestelde specificaties, planning, budget en kwaliteitseisen soepel op elkaar af te stemmen? Dan zoeken we jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Projectcoördinator heb je een verscheidenheid aan verantwoordelijkheden, jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • Bevorderen van een veilige werkomgeving, signaleren van onveilige situaties en toezien op naleving van veiligheids-, Arbo-, milieu- en kwaliteitsvoorschriften.
  • Coördineren van projecten van opname tot oplevering, inclusief technisch plan, werkpakketten, CAD-tekeningen, materiaalspecificaties en leverancierselectie.
  • Bewaken van materiaal- en gereedschapsvoorraad, kwaliteitscontrole, urenregistratie, meer-/minderwerk en projectrapportages.
  • Afstemmen met interne teams, klanten en subcontractors; opstellen van offertes, rapporten en projectcorrespondentie.
  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen het projectteam, coachen van teamleden en bewaken van voortgang en actiepunten.
Wat bieden wij?
  • Een salaris tussen de €3.700,- en €5.100,- bruto per maand o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband.
  • 27 vakantiedagen, 13 ADV-dagen en 8% vakantiegeld (CAO Metalektro).
  • Uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en professionele organisatie.
  • Mogelijkheid om projecten zelfstandig te coördineren en je kennis verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Werken in een team dat veiligheid, innovatie en kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel heeft.
Waar ga je werken?

Je komt te werken in een toonaangevend bedrijf dat zich bezig houdt met de techniek en het onderhoud van het bagagetransport op Schiphol. Ze staan bekend om hun focus op veiligheid, kwaliteit en innovatieve projectoplossingen.

Wat vragen wij?
  • 2-5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van projectmatig- en veilig werken volgens voorschriften.
  • In het bezit van VCA-VOL en NEN3140 certificaat.
  • Ervaring met verschillende softwarepakketten.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Resultaatgericht, nauwkeurig, communicatief vaardig en proactief.
Interesse?

Is dit de vacature die perfect past bij jouw skillset? Enthousiast geworden? Wacht dan niet langer en reageer nu via de solliciteerbutton!

title: Senior Software Tester
Officier Cyber (HBO/WO)
description:
Introtekst

Defensie voert operaties uit om de nationale en internationale veiligheid te bevorderen. Het gevecht winnen hoort daar bij. Ook in het cyberdomein. Als Officier Cyber kun je binnen het Defensie cyberdomein jouw kennis en kunde daar voor inzetten!

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat jouw kennis en kunde over cyber operationeel inzetten; dat wil zeggen aan boord van een schip, in het veld of vanachter een bureau. Dat doe je voor de voorbereiding en uitvoering van defensieve en offensieve operaties, zoals het beveiligen van de eigen systemen en mensen, door systemen te  hacken en het inzetten van digitale sensoren. Je krijgt daarnaast de mogelijkheid je permanent te ontwikkelen. Denk daarbij aan software schrijven, cyberacties plannen en instructie geven. Kortom; een uitdagende baan met veel verschillende facetten uit het cyberdomein binnen een unieke organisatie.
PLUSPUNTEN VAN DEZE FUNCTIE
Salaris: je bruto basissalaris levert door toeslagen en onze gunstige reiskosten, pensioen- en ziektekostenregeling je netto een aangename verrassing op.
Werksfeer: nergens maak je deel uit van zo’n hecht team van collega’s als bij Defensie.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: Defensie is naast werkgever ook een groot opleidingsinstituut, waar je opleidingen kunt volgen om persoonlijk en professioneel te groeien.

Hier ga je werken

Je begint met de Specialistenopleiding die ongeveer 10 weken duurt aan de Koninklijk Instituut voor de Marine in Den Helder. Hierna wordt je 10 weken bij CZSK geplaatst om kennis te maken met het Maritieme Cyberdomein. Daarna word je geplaatst bij een afdeling binnen het Cyberdomein van Defensie.
